cheapEat.name: Bocadillo de calamares
cheapEat.note: Madrid's classic fried-squid roll; €5-6.50 in a 2026 guide, under €6 at most counters

cheapEat.name: Esmorzaret: bocadillo, drink, coffee
cheapEat.note: Valencian second breakfast; €6.50 in Oct-Nov 2025 reviews, a guide says €5-6

VLC.saveTip: Make the weekday menú del día at lunch your main meal, as it averages about €13 in Valencia (2024 survey).

cheapEat.name: Espeto de sardinas
cheapEat.note: Beach-grilled sardine skewer; about €3-4 at chiringuitos, some at €2 in Mar 2026

AGP.saveTip: Make the menú del día at lunch your main meal, as it averages about €13.40 in Andalucía (2025 survey).

SVQ.saveTip: Pick bars without an English menu, where prices are likely lower, and order tinto de verano, often cheaper than sangría.

PMI.saveTip: Make the menú del día at lunch your main meal, as it averages about €16 in the Balearic Islands (2025 survey).

cheapEat.name: Papas arrugadas con mojo
cheapEat.note: Canary staple, often served as a tapa; €4-6 a ración in a 2026 Tenerife guide

LPA.saveTip: Lunch on the menú del día in San Telmo's inexpensive restaurants, as Las Palmas averages about €13 (2024 survey).

cheapEat.name: Papas arrugadas con mojo
cheapEat.note: Salted wrinkled potatoes with sauce; €4-6 in the north, up to €9 in the south (2026)

cheapEat.name: Souvlaki pita
cheapEat.note: Pork or chicken pitta; €5.50 on Souvlaki.gr's Larnaca Wolt menu (undated)

LCA.saveTip: Skip the beachfront seafood places and eat where Cypriots do, as prices away from tourist beaches are more moderate.

cheapEat.name: Bifana (pork roll)
cheapEat.note: Pork-loin sandwich; €2.50-4.50 at traditional tascas in a recent guide

LIS.saveTip: Order the prato do dia from the sheet on the door, and leave the unrequested couvert untouched so it is not charged.

OPO.saveTip: At prato do dia eateries, say you enjoyed the soup and politely ask for a little more if you are still hungry.

cheapEat.name: Bolo do caco with garlic butter
cheapEat.note: Madeiran flatbread snack; €2-5 in a Funchal dish guide

cheapEat.name: Panzerotto at Luini
cheapEat.note: Fried mozzarella-tomato calzone near the Duomo; €3.20-3.50 in Apr 2025

MIL.saveTip: Go for aperitivo from about 19:00, when many bars serve a fixed-price drink with a free snack buffet.

VCE.saveTip: Eat and drink standing at the bar like Venetians, since seated prices for the same cicchetti and coffee can be double.

NAP.saveTip: Snack on street food such as pizza fritta (€2-4) or a sfogliatella (€1.50-3) instead of sit-down meals.

cheapEat.name: Tigelle (four or five pieces)
cheapEat.note: €1.70-1.90 each at Tigellino (Wikivoyage); baskets run €7-12 in a 2026 guide

FLR.saveTip: Have coffee standing at the bar (al banco), where a cappuccino costs €1-3 against about €4 at a table.

cheapEat.name: Tramezzino sandwich
cheapEat.note: Crustless triangle sandwich devised in Turin in 1925; €2-5 at bars (2026 guide)

TRN.saveTip: Refill at the green-bull 'turet' fountains and ask restaurants for a carafe of tap water instead of bottled.

CTA.saveTip: Have a cold panino made to order at a salumeria for €1-3, remembering most close 13:00-16:00 and Sunday afternoons.

PMO.saveTip: Graze at the old-centre sandwich stands and Ballarò market, where panelle, arancina and sfincione cost about €2-4 each.

BRI.saveTip: Lunch on focaccia barese (about €2 a slice) or a €1-2 bag of sgagliozze in Bari Vecchia instead of a sit-down meal.

cheapEat.name: Panino caldaia (boiled pork)
cheapEat.note: Hot boiled-pork roll at a Trieste buffet; €5.00 on Buffet L'Approdo's menu (undated)

TRS.saveTip: Lunch at a traditional Trieste buffet, where hot pork and sausage rolls cost about €4-5, instead of a sit-down meal.

cheapEat.name: Takeaway pita souvlaki
cheapEat.note: Mitropoleos pita shops; Athens averages about €4 in an Apr 2026 report

ATH.saveTip: At the Mitropoleos souvlaki shops ask for the takeaway pita, not the seated plate, which Wikivoyage lists at about €9.

SKG.saveTip: Have breakfast at a bakery (fourno) on koulouri, tiropita or bougatsa rather than a café, where coffee alone costs €3-5.

IST.saveTip: Eat lunch at an esnaf lokantası (old-school canteen) and always ask the price first where none is displayed.

SOF.saveTip: Breakfast on banitsa from a bakery with ayran or boza, and grab takeaway pizza slices or sandwiches for under €2.

cheapEat.name: Covrigi pretzel at LUCA
cheapEat.note: Warm soft pretzel at LUCA counters; RON 4-6 in a 2026 guide

BUH.saveTip: Graze at Piața Obor market stalls, where mici with bread and a lager cost under 35 RON and lángos RON 15-22.

SPU.saveTip: Buy fruit, vegetables and picnic food at the Pazar farmers market, which Wikivoyage says is best on weekend mornings.

LJU.saveTip: Drink at bars just outside the old town or near the university, which Wikivoyage says are cheaper.

TIA.saveTip: Eat at cantina-style local restaurants (daily dishes 200-400 lek, about €2-4) rather than the fancier Blloku places.

cheapEat.name: Ćevapi in somun flatbread
cheapEat.note: 10-12 KM a portion in a 2026 guide; Wikivoyage listed 6 KM in 2019

SJJ.saveTip: Eat burek or pita from a buregdžinica, about 4-7 KM per 200 g (€2-3.60), rather than at sit-down restaurants.

BEG.saveTip: Have burek with drinkable yoghurt from any pekara for breakfast, as slices run about 150-300 RSD (€1.30-2.60).

MLA.saveTip: Look for traditional bakeries and pastizzerie, where Wikivoyage says bread costs mere cents and a pastizz 30-50 cents.
